but.definitionKo: 그렇게 말하기에는 조금 지나친 면도 있지만.
but.englishExpression: It is nonsensical to say so, but
but.englishDescription: Although it may be too extreme to say so.

computer.definitionKo: 전자 회로를 이용하여 문서, 사진, 영상 등의 대량의 데이터를 빠르고 정확하게 처리하는 기계.
computer.englishDescription: A machine made from electronic circuits that quickly and accurately processes mass data such as documents, photographs, videos, etc.

cracker.definitionKo: 얇은 밀가루 반죽을 발효하여 딱딱하게 구운 서양 과자.
cracker.englishDescription: A western cookie made by fermenting thin flour dough and baking it until it becomes hard.

measurement.englishDescription: A size or measurement of clothing, shoes, etc.

mileage.definitionKo: 상품을 구매하거나 카드를 사용하는 실적에 따라 쌓이는 보너스 점수.
mileage.englishDescription: Bonus points that are accumulated according to purchase of product or card transaction history.

pincers.definitionKo: 손에 쥐고 철사를 끊거나 구부리거나 하는 데에 쓰는 도구.
pincers.englishDescription: An hand tool used to cut or bend steel wires.

rock.englishDescription: Popular music that originated in the United States in the 1950s.

tibet.definitionKo: 중국 남서부에 있는 티베트족의 자치구. 주민 대부분이 불교를 믿으며, 지구상에서 평균 고도가 가장 높은 곳이다. 중심 도시는 라싸이다.
tibet.englishDescription: The autonomous district of Tibetan people, which is located in the southwestern part of China; most of its residents believe in Buddhism; it has the highest average altitude on the Earth; its central city is Lhasa.

uzbekistan.definitionKo: 중앙아시아에 있는 나라. 관개 농업이 발달하였으며 주요 생산물은 목화이다. 주민 대부분이 이슬람교도이다. 공용어는 우즈베크어이고 수도는 타슈켄트이다.
uzbekistan.englishDescription: A country located in Central Asia; it is known for advanced irrigation farming and as a major producer of cotton; most of its people are Muslims; its official language is Uzbek and its capital is Tashkent.
